comments: Each 970-px band is cut to the canvas aspect by a reviewed crop of its TOP rows (the horizon stays on the bottom edge) and BOX reduced once, 2.53 to 1; no squash, the importer never stretches. The lane's suggestion of cropping to 3.2 to 1 and squashing seven percent is not taken.

All four bands wrap sideways (the second sheet keeps its clouds clear of the side edges). The stage maps azimuth to x and elevation to y and lays the sky behind the 3D canyon; nothing here sets the horizon or the moon.
geometry: Painted into the sky's dots behind the 3D canyon, never a mesh; the horizon, the camera heading and the stage's own sky states choose which band and where; art never sets a hitbox (none).
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet (the run's second image, source-sheet-2.png) and its four bands cut by magenta detection, 2026-10-19. Reading order equals the slot order: dusk (teal moon right of centre, amber band on the bottom edge), smoke (dark banks, ember glow low), dawn (cream-gold horizon, amber-lit streaks) and clouds (five banks on plain dusk, no moon).
size_basis: native canvas 384x112 (opaque), one band of the sky; anchor bottom-centre (192,112); stage 384x224.
timing: dusk 1 ticks; smoke 1 ticks; dawn 1 ticks; clouds 1 ticks (30 Hz). Durations are the rules' and live in assets/griffinwing/slots.json.
